board_identity: THE DIAMONDEDGE PICK — one pick per game
unified_rule: ONE pick per game: (1) if the champion has a qualifying PLAY on the game (clears its +EV gate) that IS the pick; (2) else if the v4 model grid has a playable lean (clears the +EV gate + 0.01 conviction floor) that is the pick; (3) else if the grid has an EXPANDED-band lean (2026-07-24 on: full +EV gate + conviction 0.0075-0.010 — the measured near-miss band, 104-78-4 / +15.7% ROI walk-forward backtest) that is the pick, flagged expanded_band with REGULAR display stars from the one ladder (mostly 2*), 0.5u stake rail, graded separately under record.expanded_band and folded into by_star_tier with includes_expanded_n; (4) else the game shows its best lean as a PASS (never a bet). One 0-5 score + star ladder (frozen v3.2 percentile score; v3.3 full 1-5 display bands — top ~10% of playable scores -> 5*, next ~25% -> 4*, next ~35% -> 3*, rest -> 2*, non-playable -> 1*; `certified` is a separate boolean, false everywhere today), shared by both sources; one record, graded once per game against finals. `source` is diagnostic only — the UI renders champion- and model-sourced picks identically.
score_reference_version: v3.3 (Leon, 2026-07-25: full 1-5 display scale — stars = frozen percentile bands of the unchanged v3.2 continuous score over playable rows: top ~10% -> 5*, next ~25% -> 4*, next ~35% -> 3*, rest playable -> 2*, non-playable -> 1*; BH certification is the separate `certified` boolean, no longer the 5* gate)

star_cutoffs.version: v3.3 (Leon, 2026-07-25: full 1-5 display scale — stars = frozen percentile bands of the unchanged v3.2 continuous score over playable rows: top ~10% -> 5*, next ~25% -> 4*, next ~35% -> 3*, rest playable -> 2*, non-playable -> 1*; BH certification is the separate `certified` boolean, no longer the 5* gate)
star_cutoffs.basis: v3.3 percentile display bands of the (unchanged) v3.2 continuous score over ALL playable rows of the season replay (v4 totals grid + champion_v2 2026 backfill). Frozen ABSOLUTE score thresholds for live serving — recomputed only when the replay payload regenerates (nightly), never per-day. The -EV floor is hard: non-playable rows stay 1* regardless of score. `certified` (BH significance) is a separate boolean — no display band claims certification.
star_cutoffs.bands: v3.3 percentile display bands of the continuous v3.2 score over playable rows: score >= cutoff_5 -> 5* (top ~10%), >= cutoff_4 -> 4* (next ~25%), >= cutoff_3 -> 3* (next ~35%), else 2*; 1* = non-playable (hard -EV floor). `certified` (BH significance) is a separate boolean — no star band claims certification.

score_basis.recipe: logit(p_cal) = logit(p_mkt) + s * (logit(p_our) - logit(p_mkt)); s fit by penalized IRLS with identity prior s~N(1, 1/25), clamped to [0, 1.25]; NO intercept (the layer refuses to learn the trailing window's over/under rate); expanding-window walk-forward fit on the engine's own graded FG-totals rows (2026 replay pre-block + served graded ledger, y = final vs judged line, pushes/voids dropped, strictly date < D); refit per serve date, frozen first-fit-wins; inactive (identity) below 300 rows / 10 graded days
score_basis.scope: v4 model-grid FULL-GAME TOTALS our_prob only — champion-stream picks, spread/ML/F5 rows, the EV-gate math and every score/star band cutoff are untouched; they simply receive the calibrated probability
score_basis.note: SCORE BASIS CHANGE (activation-dated 2026-07-27, forward only): the model grid's served probability passes through a walk-forward market-anchored calibration map fitted on strictly-past graded picks before the (unchanged) EV gate and score pipeline. Locked picks, graded history and every past score/record are NEVER restated. A calibrated row can never flip sides — only its stated conviction changes. This does NOT create edge and no edge is claimed: it makes the confidence number mean what it says.

signals_note: signals are contextual factors aligned with the lean, not causal attribution — the model is market-anchored and its number is not derived from these factors

expanded_band.rule: model-grid rows with the FULL +EV gate (ev >= 0.015, unchanged) and conviction 0.0075 <= |our_prob - market_devig| < 0.010 are playable 2* fills from the activation date forward — the exact measured near-miss band; every adjacent band (conviction 0.0050-0.0075, any EV-gate relaxation) measured as a loser and stays PASS

backtest.window: 2026-03-25..2026-07-23 (walk-forward rows only; one game per day-game, best-EV wall; graded vs settled finals at the row's own executable price)
backtest.note: BACKTEST (would-have) record — NOT a served record. The served expanded-band record accrues from EXPANDED_BAND_START under record.by_star_tier['2_expanded'], separately from core 2*.

expanded_band.rails: expanded_band=true on the pick; REGULAR display stars from the one v3.3 ladder (mostly 2* — no separate display row; record.by_star_tier carries includes_expanded_n per tier); 0.5u stake regardless of display stars; graded separately (record.expanded_band.served_record); a core playable row always beats an expanded row on the same game; history is never retroactively promoted

The 2026-07-27 DERIV_RUNLINE_MARGIN_REPORT verdict was BLOCKED (prereg K1: margin fitness gate failed — no home-field advantage in the engine; and every declared arm, including the no-sim control, lost to the de-vigged market on Brier), so lean_only stands. analyst_desk_spec.per_game_fields: games[].analysts = [{key, name, persona_line, side (over|under|null), p_over, conviction (0-1, P(stated side), calibrated where the engine has a calibration — see each analyst's conviction_basis), locked, wall, has_row, take, take_kind}] — ALWAYS all four, in `order`; null side = no read yet (pre-wall or no view; has_row=false means the engine has not priced the game at all). ANALYST VOICES (2026-07-30): `take` is a 1-2 sentence line in the persona's voice rendered FROM THAT ENGINE'S OWN ROW DATA (analyst_takes.py template libraries — deterministic per analyst x game, byte-stable across regenerations); every number in a take is validator-checked to exist in the source row — nothing fabricated, ever. take_kind is standard | dissent (the lone voice against >= 2 opposing reads argues back) | no_read. LIVE ATLAS (2026-07-30): on LIVE games the atlas entry gains {live_p_over, live_state_note, as_of} — the certified conditional simulator re-pricing P(over the pregame line) from the actual game state, ONLY inside its certified fitness buckets (v4/serve/live_atlas.py); outside them live_p_over is null and the note says the desk is watching. DISPLAY ONLY, forever: never graded, never a bet, never touches any record. games[].consensus = {n_over, n_under, n_no_read, state UNANIMOUS|MAJORITY|SPLIT|PENDING, majority_side, spread: {n_home, n_away, n_no_read, state, majority_side, voices, note}} — UNANIMOUS requires all FOUR to agree; MAJORITY is a strict majority of those with reads; SPLIT is a tie of reads; PENDING is no reads. The spread dimension counts the desk's margin voices only (ATLAS + NOVA); VEGA and SCOUT have no margin view and are honest no-reads there. FULL COVERAGE (2026-07-30): every entry also carries {vs_line (the EXACT line that engine was priced against — render it as 'ATLAS: OVER 8.5 (priced vs 8.5)'), vs_line_is_pregame_line (bool|null vs the LOCKED pregame line), coverage_expanded, coverage_kind (market_signal|engine_backfill|null), coverage_activation, low_conviction, conviction_calibrated}. A coverage entry is a FORCED-COVERAGE read: the engine had no native row, so the desk filled the slot — VEGA from its own market microstructure (line move / sharp divergence / book-median de-vig, conviction capped at 0.53), ATLAS and SCOUT from their own engines run on the latest arrived pregame wall. take_kind gains `coverage` for those. Coverage reads grade in their OWN ledger (record.coverage) and NEVER enter record.analysts. games[].pregame_line = {total, total_price_over, total_price_under, run_line, run_line_price_home, run_line_price_away, book, captured_at, wall, locked_at, is_locked, total_open, total_move, p_over_devig, n_books, first_captured_at, source, note} | null — the market state at the last wall before first pitch, WRITE-ONCE and immutable from the moment locked_at is stamped. games[].line_now = {total, pregame_total_compared, total_price_over, total_price_under, book(null), comparison_basis('book_consensus_median'), same_basis:true, same_book_check {book, pregame_total, total, move, total_price_over, total_price_under} | null, n_books, as_of, source, market:'full_game_total', moved_vs_pregame, move, max_plausible_move, display_only:true, note} | null — the CURRENT read of the SAME full-game pregame totals market the locked line came from, so a pregame move never mutates the locked line. FOUR RAILS the frontend can rely on: (1) it is ALWAYS the same market — in-play/remaining-runs totals are never a source; (2) it is NULL for any game that has started (after first pitch there is no pregame market to compare to — render the locked line alone); (3) books are NEVER mixed and the headline ALWAYS reconciles with what is on screen: both sides are the same consensus-median basis, so `move` is exactly `line_now.total - pregame_line.total` and `pregame_total_compared` always equals `pregame_line.total` (the anchor book's own move is corroboration only, in `same_book_check`); (4) a comparison implying a move larger than `max_plausible_move` runs, or one where the same-book check moves the opposite way, is refused and logged in payload.line_now_audit, never shipped. So 'MARKET MOVED' should only ever render off a real, plausible, arithmetically-reconciling `move`. games[].live_progress = {status:'in_progress', inning, half, outs, away_score, home_score, runs_so_far, pregame_total, runs_vs_pregame_total, runs_still_needed_for_over, innings_elapsed, pace_runs_per_inning, projected_final_runs, p_hit_now, p_hit_side, p_hit_side_basis, p_hit_certified, p_hit_basis, p_hit_buckets, p_hit_note, live_p_over, as_of, display_only:true, note} | null — p_hit_now is the probability the PREGAME pick still cashes and is populated ONLY inside the live simulator's CERTIFIED buckets (p_hit_certified true); outside them it is null. Every live number is display-only and touches no record. games[].diamondedge = the synthesis frame: the served pick's mirror (side/line/stars/score/price/result/...) + {consensus_state, action PLAY|LEAN|AVOID, action_basis, desk_agreement ALIGNED|MIXED|AGAINST|PENDING, is_bet, action_before_pattern, pattern_downgraded, confidence_rank (3=PLAY,2=LEAN,1=AVOID), rationale_line, pattern, pattern_line, synthesis_config_version, spread_call, predicted_score, chief, note}. THE ACTION INVARIANT (2026-07-31): action == 'AVOID' IF AND ONLY IF no bet was served (pick.status != 'PICK'). A served bet displays PLAY (stars >= 3) or LEAN, never AVOID, and the rationale_line on a served bet never contains passing language. The desk's disagreement with a served side lives in `desk_agreement` and is spoken as context. games[].diamondedge.chief = THE CHIEF (2026-07-30), the PREGAME synthesis: {scope:'pregame', ou_call: {side, side_basis served_bet|desk_majority|no_read, line, line_basis served_bet_line|locked_pregame_total, pregame_total, line_matches_pregame_total, line_is_locked_pregame, price, desk_votes, desk_majority_side, desk_agreement, engine_pick_status, engine_pick_side, stars, is_bet, note}, spread_call, predicted_score, desk_fit, desk_combined, coherence, consensus_state, desk_agreement, action, action_basis, is_bet, confidence_rank, pattern, pattern_line, pattern_downgraded, rationale_line, synthesis_config_version, note}. COHERENCE: `ou_call.side` IS the served bet whenever one was served (side_basis='served_bet'), and `ou_call.line` is that bet's OWN line (line_basis='served_bet_line'), with the locked pregame total carried beside it in `pregame_total` and `line_matches_pregame_total`. Both used to default to the desk majority / the pregame total, which let a card print 'OVER 8.0' directly above an under-7.5 ticket. games[].diamondedge.chief.coherence = {the_bet {side, line, price, stars} | null, is_bet, reference_side, voices {desk_majority, desk_combined, atlas_predicted_score} each {side, ..., vs_bet same|opposite|null}, all_voices_agree_with_bet, run_line_is_a_separate_market, note} — the card carries several O/U-relevant readings and they can disagree; this reconciles each against THE BET and states plainly that only `the_bet` is a bet. A voice pointing the other way is information, not a contradiction. desk_agreement is ALIGNED | MIXED | AGAINST | PENDING | NO_BET (NO_BET = nothing was served, so there is no side to agree with). The chief's language and its confidence ordering are PATTERN-AWARE (record.patterns): on a unanimous game where unanimity measures below 50% the chief says so and the displayed action moves DOWN one rung. It can only ever move DOWN, a PASS never becomes a PLAY, and on a SERVED BET the ladder bottoms out at LEAN. games[].diamondedge.chief.desk_fit = THE ROLLING DESK FIT (2026-07-31): {status, updated, window_days:30, window, window_n_games, reads_by_analyst, fitted_weights, fitted_weights_ci95, fitted_weights_se, any_weight_separates_from_zero, weights_basis (fitted|equal_weight), effective_weights, verdict (fitted_weights|equal_weight_fallback), fitted_weights_adopted, why[], gate, walk_forward {n_games_scored, n_days_scored, span, mean_logloss {fitted, equal_weight, market}, fitted_vs_equal / equal_vs_market / fitted_vs_market {delta_logloss, ci95, better, worse, separated, n_games, n_days, bootstrap_B, bootstrap_seed, clustered_by}, side_hit_vs_market}, headline, model, baselines, caveats[], honest_note, presentation_only:true}. The nightly ridge-logistic fit of each analyst's LOG-ODDS DISAGREEMENT WITH THE PRICE over the trailing 30 days, scored WALK-FORWARD against two baselines (equal weighting and the price itself) with day-clustered bootstrap intervals. Fitted weights are ADOPTED only when the window can support four of them and they beat equal weighting with an interval strictly better than zero; otherwise the desk uses EQUAL WEIGHTS and `why` says why in plain English. games[].diamondedge.chief.desk_combined = the per-game combination under the EFFECTIVE weights {p_over, side, p_market, divergence_logodds, weights_basis, weights, voices_used, voices_excluded, window_days, verdict, display_only:true, is_bet:false, note} | null — DISPLAY ONLY, graded nowhere, and it never changes the action. spread_call = {side home|away|null, side_team, line, home_line, rationale_line, voices, is_bet:false, note} | null. predicted_score = {away, home, source:'ATLAS', p_home_win, wall, note} | null — per-team medians from the sim's joint distribution; display only, graded nowhere.

action_vocabulary.PLAY: A BET WAS SERVED at the product's higher conviction tier (stars >= 3). The +EV gate and the star system made it; the desk did not.
action_vocabulary.LEAN: A BET WAS SERVED at the lower star tier — or a served bet the measured pattern table sized down. A served bet can never display below LEAN.
action_vocabulary.AVOID: NO BET WAS SERVED (pick.status is PASS or VOID). This is the ONLY meaning of AVOID. It is an INVARIANT, asserted in the selftest: the chief can never tell a reader the desk is passing on a bet the engine actually served.
action_vocabulary.why: the action was a four-way vote; because the served pick's own side is one of the four voices and full coverage (2026-07-30) gave all four a read on every game, three near-coin-flip voices outvoted the picking engine on roughly half of all served bets — so the product served a bet and said 'we're passing' on the same card. Configuration must not drive the recommendation (across 2,972 games no consensus configuration separates from chance), so it no longer does: PLAY vs LEAN is grounded in the star tier, the one confidence ladder here with a measured calibration.
action_vocabulary.where_the_disagreement_went: games[].diamondedge.desk_agreement and .chief.ou_call.desk_agreement = ALIGNED | MIXED | AGAINST | PENDING, plus the rationale_line, which says it in plain English. AGAINST on a served bet is stated as context, never as a veto.

What each analyst has been MEASURED to do, replacing written prose on the roster page. Recomputed nightly off v4/models/analyst_lab/runs/latest.json. Each row = {analyst, axis (display label), axis_key (raw column), cell, n, win, loss, hit_rate, hit_ci95 (EXACT Clopper-Pearson 95%), baseline_hit_rate (the SAME analyst's complement, not 50% and not another analyst), baseline_n, delta_vs_baseline, direction ('strong'|'weak'|'flat'), ci_excludes_baseline (uncorrected), p_two_sided (EXACT two-sided Fisher vs its own complement), test, bh_significant, roi_flat110 (flat -110 convention, diagnostic only), line (the rendered sentence — the interval is INSIDE it; render `line` verbatim, never a bare hit_rate), selection}. THREE RENDERING RAILS. (1) ONLY rows in `characteristics` may be shown as something an analyst does; every one of them carries bh_significant true by construction. (2) A row's `line` already contains n and the exact interval — do not strip it down to a percentage. (3) When any_characteristic is false the profile is NOT empty: render profiles[key].headline, which states the null. Nothing on this block gates, sizes or creates a bet. record.coverage = {activation_date, by_analyst: {vega|atlas|nova|scout: {analyst, activation_date, is_betting_record:false, n, win, loss, push, hit_rate, first_graded_date, last_graded_date, note}}, note} — the forced-coverage reads' OWN graded ledger, never summed with record.analysts. payload.board_coverage = {n_games, by_analyst: {key: {reads, native, coverage, no_read}}, by_date, n_no_reads, coverage_activation, note} — the coverage proof over the served cards themselves. payload.line_now_audit = {n_emitted, n_suppressed_started, n_suppressed_implausible, n_suppressed_basis_disagreement, n_no_current, n_no_pregame, max_plausible_move, rejects[{game_pk, date, pregame, now, move, basis, book, reason}], note} — every line_now comparison the guards REFUSED, with both numbers and the reason. Every row carries its n and an EXACT binomial (Clopper-Pearson) 95% interval; a hit rate whose interval straddles 50% is a coin flip no matter how far from 50% the point estimate looks, and a row is a FINDING only if it survives ONE Benjamini-Hochberg pass across the entire rendered family. THE BUCKETS MOVED AND THAT IS NOT A RESULT: the re-architecture decorrelated the four deliberately, so they disagree far more (side agreement fell from 0.84-0.89 to 0.51-0.57) and all sixteen configurations now occur where most previously never did. The corpus restarts at 2026-07-01, the day after the training fence of 2026-06-30, so it is genuinely out of sample and genuinely small — it will stay small for months and the intervals say so. analyst_desk_spec.positioning: THE ANALYST DESK (Leon, 2026-07-30): the home screen is a competition — four named analysts, each a real graded engine, call every game; the desk states its consensus and DiamondEdge synthesizes the final frame. SEMANTICS (2026-07-31): the frame follows THE BET, not the vote — a served bet reads PLAY or LEAN by its star tier, a game with no served bet reads AVOID, and the desk's agreement or disagreement is rendered alongside as context. The desk weights its analysts by a nightly rolling 30-day fit of their disagreement with the price (chief.desk_fit), which falls back to equal weighting — and says so — whenever the fit cannot beat equal weighting walk-forward, which is the state today. The underlying pick machinery, every record, and every honesty rail are UNCHANGED underneath.

why: the trailing 30-day window holds 169 graded games, below the 300-game floor for fitting four weights
below the 100-read floor in this window: VEGA 23, ATLAS 25, SCOUT 6
walk-forward, the fitted weights are not distinguishable from equal weighting (delta log-loss +0.00006, 95% CI [-0.00009, +0.00021] on 11786 games over 860 days)
rolling_desk_fit.gate: adopt fitted weights only when the trailing window holds >= 300 graded games with >= 100 reads for every analyst AND the walk-forward log-loss improvement over equal weighting has a 95% day-clustered interval strictly better than zero
rolling_desk_fit.headline: Fitting the four analysts' disagreement-with-the-price over a rolling 30-day window does NOT beat weighting them equally: walk-forward over 11786 games and 860 days the log-loss difference is +0.00006 (95% CI [-0.00009, +0.00021]). The desk uses EQUAL WEIGHTS. Neither is the combined desk distinguishable from simply using the price.
rolling_desk_fit.model: P(over) = sigmoid( logit(p_mkt) + b + SUM_a w_a * d_a ), d_a = logit(p_over_a) - logit(p_mkt_a), 0 where analyst a has no read. The market log-odds are a FIXED OFFSET, so w_a asks only whether that analyst's disagreement with the number adds anything the number does not already carry. Ridge-penalised (lambda pre-specified, not scanned), fit by IRLS, standard errors from the penalised Hessian.
rolling_desk_fit.baselines: EQUAL WEIGHT = the same model with one shared coefficient on the mean divergence of the analysts who read the game, fit on the same window — so the comparison isolates differential weighting. MARKET = p_mkt untouched.
caveats: The reconstructed 2022-2023 slice sits inside the DEV window the four recipes were selected on: each read is walk-forward, but the analysts are flattered there relative to true out-of-sample. That matters for reading the LEVEL of any number here and is second-order for the fitted-vs-equal CONTRAST, which is the thing the gate turns on.

The four analysts are highly correlated today (all four sit within a couple of points of 50% on their own sides, and the profile pass found no measurable specialism across 357 cells). A combiner over correlated near-coin-flips has almost nothing to separate, which is exactly why the honest output is equal weighting. This is a statement about the CURRENT roster, not about the method.

The live trailing window is still thin: the desk went live 2026-07-30 and the reconstruction stops in 2026-04, so a 30-day window ending today does not carry enough reads per analyst to fit four weights at all.
rolling_desk_fit.honest_note: THE ROLLING DESK FIT IS A MEASUREMENT, NOT A BET RULE. It re-fits every night over the trailing 30 days how each analyst's DISAGREEMENT WITH THE PRICE has related to results, scores that fit WALK-FORWARD (fit strictly on days before the day it is scored on, never on the days it is scored on), and compares it to two baselines: equal weighting and the price itself. Fitted weights are only ever ADOPTED when the walk-forward improvement over equal weighting has an interval strictly better than zero AND the window carries enough reads to fit four weights. When it does not — which is the state today — the desk uses EQUAL WEIGHTS and this block says so with the numbers, because presenting a fitted weight whose interval straddles the equal-weight baseline is presenting noise as insight. Nothing here gates, sizes or grades a bet: the +EV gate and the star system remain the only things that make a bet, and the combined probability is display only, graded nowhere.

constants.chief_note: THE CHIEF (Leon, 2026-07-30; SEMANTICS REWRITTEN 2026-07-31): DiamondEdge's own PREGAME synthesis — the O/U call, the run-line call and the predicted final score, all against the LOCKED pregame line, with a rationale grounded in the MEASURED tables. THE COHERENCE RULE (the 2026-07-31 fix): when the engine SERVED A BET, the chief's O/U call IS that bet — same side, same number — and the action can never be AVOID. AVOID means, and only ever means, that no bet was served. The desk's disagreement with a served bet is real and is stated (desk_agreement + the rationale line), but it is stated as CONTEXT, never as 'we're passing' on a bet we are actually making. The chief remains PRESENTATION and ROUTING ONLY: the measured pattern table can change the language and move a displayed action DOWN one rung, never up, a PASS can never become a PLAY, and on a served bet the ladder bottoms out at LEAN. Betting stays with the +EV gate and the star system, exactly as before. predicted_score and desk_combined are display predictions, graded nowhere.
constants.ou_call_note: side IS the served bet whenever one was served (side_basis=served_bet); it falls back to the desk's own majority lean only when nothing was served, and a lean is never a bet.
constants.coherence_note: THE BET IS `the_bet` and nothing else on this card is a bet. The desk's majority lean, the desk's weighted combination and ATLAS's predicted final score are three DISPLAY readings of the same game; each is reported here with whether it points the same way as the ticket. A voice pointing the other way is information, not a contradiction — none of them clears a price gate, and none of them is graded. The run line is a separate market and is never expected to agree with a total.

vega.title: THE PRICE
vega.thesis: The number is the evidence, so I grade the market and nothing else: where it opened, how far it moved, how much the books disagree and what the two sides actually cost.
vega.note: VEGA is the ONLY analyst for which the market is a model input. It is also the only one that prices a PROBABILITY rather than projecting a total: its model is a residual on logit(de-vigged market probability), which is what a market reader actually does.
vega.formula: logit(p_over) = logit(p_market) + -0.0542 +0.0000*z[line_move] +0.0000*z[move_pace] -0.0030*z[time_since_move] +0.1270*z[book_disagreement] -0.0494*z[price_dispersion] +0.0169*z[sharp_gap] +0.0263*z[n_books] -0.0664*z[stale_gap]   ;   side = over if p_over > p_market else under

atlas.title: THE CONDITIONS
atlas.thesis: Runs are a physical event, so I grade the place and the man behind the plate: the park's run factor, its altitude and roof, day or night, and how many runs this umpire's games actually produce.
atlas.note: WEATHER IS NOT IN THIS SLICE AND THAT IS A DATA FACT, NOT A CHOICE: wx_* fill is 0.356 in 2025 and 0.006 in 2026, and what exists is ERA5 proxy_ablation which house policy excludes from every clean variant. ATLAS's environment is park + altitude + roof + day/night + umpire run tendency. If a real forward weather feed ever lands, wx_* is the first thing that belongs here.
atlas.formula: delta_runs = (+0.2723*z[park_run_factor] +0.2801*z[park_altitude] -0.1607*z[park_roof] +0.0000*z[is_night] +0.0970*z[ump_runs] -0.0321*z[ump_strikeouts] +0.0000*z[ump_walks]) - -0.0044   ;   p_over = Phi(delta / 4.537)   ;   side = over if delta > 0 else under   ;   projected total shown = posted line + delta   [context-free absolute projection, diagnostic only: mu_absolute = 8.9160 + the same linear term]

nova.title: THE BATS
nova.thesis: Runs come from bats, so I grade the hitters and nothing else: the nine names actually posted tonight against the hand they will face, and how the two offenses have actually been scoring.
nova.note: NOVA's lineup-vs-hand feature is computed by the enrich layer against the opposing starter's throwing HAND. A hand is an IDENTITY, not a quality: no measure of how good that pitcher is ever reaches NOVA, and no `sp_*` column is in its slice.
nova.formula: delta_runs = (+0.0000*z[bats_vs_hand] +0.1265*z[bats_woba] +0.2754*z[bats_power] +0.0000*z[bats_onbase] +0.0000*z[bats_scoring_form] +0.0000*z[bats_strikeouts] -0.0287*z[bats_lineups_known]) - 0.0158   ;   p_over = Phi(delta / 4.550)   ;   side = over if delta > 0 else under   ;   projected total shown = posted line + delta   [context-free absolute projection, diagnostic only: mu_absolute = 8.9160 + the same linear term]

scout.title: THE ARMS
scout.thesis: Runs come from bad pitching, so I grade the arms and nothing else: the two starters who open the game and the bullpens behind them — weak staffs mean runs, and I lean over.
scout.formula: delta_runs = (+0.0000*z[sp_fip] +0.1898*z[sp_contact_quality] +0.1391*z[sp_recent_form] -0.0772*z[sp_length] -0.1028*z[sp_groundballs] -0.0420*z[sp_rest] +0.2017*z[pen_era] +0.0000*z[pen_workload] +0.0000*z[pen_back_to_back] +0.0000*z[pen_closer_available]) - 0.0296   ;   p_over = Phi(delta / 4.546)   ;   side = over if delta > 0 else under   ;   projected total shown = posted line + delta   [context-free absolute projection, diagnostic only: mu_absolute = 8.9160 + the same linear term]

analyst_v2_spec.chief_contract: THE ANALYST-STREAM CONTRACT (v2, 2026-07-31) — what the desk chief may rely on. SOURCE: v4/serve/analyst_v2_stream.reads_for_date(date) -> {game_pk: {analyst_key: read}}, read-only over the write-once board at v4/serve/state/analyst_v2_board.json. GUARANTEES: (1) at most ONE read per (date, game_pk, analyst), written once and never restated — a key already on the board is skipped, not overwritten; (2) every read carries `pick_side` in {over, under} (a read with no side is never written), `p_over` in (0,1), `market_line`, `p_mkt_over` and `edge_vs_market`; (3) the three CHANNEL analysts (scout/nova/atlas) additionally carry `delta_runs` (their signal in runs, positive = over), `center_used` (the strictly-prior trailing centre that delta is measured against), `conviction_runs` = |delta_runs|, `mu_shown` = market_line + delta_runs (the total that analyst projects for THIS game, coherent with the line by construction) and `mu_absolute` (its context-free projection, diagnostic only); VEGA carries `delta_runs`: null because it prices a probability, and its signal is `edge_vs_market`; (4) `top_drivers` is the three levers contributing most to that read, each with its z, its beta and its contribution IN RUNS — safe to render verbatim; (5) `basis` is 'reconstructed_oos' or 'live' and `trained_through` is the training fence, so the chief can weight by evidence type; (6) `is_bet` is ALWAYS false — these are reads, and the served product pick is not built from them. DECORRELATION: the four slices are disjoint and enforced by analyst_v2.slices.FeatureGate, so the chief may treat the four reads as carrying independent information about different causal channels — that is the design property a combiner should exploit. STABILITY: adding a field is allowed; removing or renaming one is a contract break and must be announced.
analyst_v2_spec.strategy_contract: games[].analysts[].strategy — the LIVE CLAUDE STRATEGY advisory, or absent. SHAPE {strategy_stance ('concur'|'caution'), strategy_caution (bool), strategy_note (one or two sentences, safe to render verbatim), cited_levers[], advisory_only:true, moved_the_pick:false, pick_side_unchanged, note, asof_utc}. WHAT IT IS: a Claude session that reasons about ONE analyst's own slice, its own reads for tonight and its own recent record. WHAT IT IS NOT: it does not and structurally cannot set a side, a probability, a line, a price or a stake — there is no such field in its response schema, the pricing fields are written write-once BEFORE any session runs, and the graded ledger is written from the untouched board row, so a session can never move an analyst's record in either direction. Every number in strategy_note is validated to be derivable from that game's own read row by analyst_takes.validate_take (the same validator the deterministic take-generator uses); a note that invents a number is dropped whole. strategy_caution is DOWNGRADE-ONLY: it may flag a game as less comfortable, never as more.
analyst_v2_spec.predicted_score_contract: games[].diamondedge.predicted_score — ATLAS's projected score. CHANGED 2026-07-31: the two numbers are now per-team EXPECTED RUNS (means), shown to one decimal, and they SUM TO `projected_total` by construction. They used to be per-team MEDIANS, which are integers and therefore collapsed most games onto 4-5, and which summed BELOW the projected total by 0.71 runs on average. SHAPE {away (float, 1dp), home (float, 1dp), source:'ATLAS', p_home_win, wall, projected_total, statistic:'expected_runs', note}. RENDERING: show one decimal — rounding to an integer reintroduces exactly the defect this fixed. It is a DISPLAY prediction, graded nowhere, and it is never a bet.
analyst_v2_spec.fence: TRAINING FENCE: every one of the four analysts is fit strictly on games dated 2025-01-01 through 2026-06-30 inclusive. No model sees a single row dated 2026-07-01 or later — the fence is asserted in dataset.assert_no_post_fence(), re-asserted by the trainer on every matrix it fits, and re-checked against every written artifact by the selftest. The live record for all four analysts begins 2026-07-01 and accrues forward.
analyst_v2_spec.seal_spend: THIS TRAINING WINDOW SPENDS SEALED DATE WINDOWS, KNOWINGLY. The program had sealed the 2024-04-01 -> 2026-04-30 confirmation corpus and the 2026-05-01+ cross-book holdout. The 2025-01-01 -> 2026-06-30 training window runs straight through both, and Leon chose that deliberately in exchange for a clean forward evaluation window that starts the day training ends. CONSEQUENCE, STATED RATHER THAN BURIED: every number computed on the training window is IN-SAMPLE and carries NO evidential weight about future performance. The only honest evidence about these four analysts is the record that accrues from 2026-07-01 forward, on data no model has ever seen.
analyst_v2_spec.what_changed: THE FOUR ANALYSTS WERE RE-ARCHITECTED ON 2026-07-31. They used to be four different ENGINES over essentially the SAME market-anchored feature space, and the measurement showed it: all four sat between 48.6% and 51.0% on their own sides, the profile pass found ZERO measurable specialisms across 357 cells after correction, and no consensus configuration separated from chance across 2,972 games. They are now four THEORIES OF A BASEBALL GAME reading DISJOINT slices of the feature space — run prevention, run production, environment, price — enforced in code by analyst_v2.slices.FeatureGate. All four were retrained on 2025-01-01 -> 2026-06-30 and all four records restart at 2026-07-01. The served pick and the champion product record are untouched by any of it.

definitions.label: The DiamondEdge Pick
definitions.what: The one pick we actually serve on this game: the champion's play if it has one, otherwise the model's best playable lean, otherwise a PASS.
definitions.basis: POPULATION: every (date, game_pk) where the served hybrid produced a graded pick — champion play if present, else the model's best playable lean — exactly one row per game. GRADING: the row's own settled result at the real executable per-side price it was served at, on the line locked at first pitch; pushes return the stake and leave the ROI denominator. HEADLINE COVERS: served picks from 2026-07-20 (the day the hybrid went live) forward only.

definitions.label: Champion engine
definitions.what: The champion engine's own totals play — its frozen pipeline plus the +EV gate at the real per-side price. It only speaks on games where its trigger fires; on every other game it has no view at all.
definitions.basis: POPULATION: every game the champion engine itself rated PLAYABLE and that settled — one row per game (its highest-score playable wall). This is NOT the champion's published headline, which counts one row per game x STREAM at the last decision wall; the two populations are reconciled to a zero residual by champion_headline_residual(). GRADING: champion_v2's own graded ledger, untouched — gate at the median de-vig price, priced and settled at the best executable price at the same line. record.by_strategy_note: READ THIS BEFORE COMPARING STRATEGIES. analysts.note: THE ANALYST SCOREBOARD, REBUILT 2026-07-31. Four analysts, four DISJOINT feature slices, one record each from 2026-07-01. There is no staked-versus-lean split any more: every analyst is scored the same way, on its own reads, one row per game, and the sample size is printed beside the rate. Records are never summed across analysts — the same game appears on all four desks. Nothing here is a bet, nothing here sizes a bet, and nothing here touches the served product pick or the champion product record.
analysts.honest_note: WHAT THIS RECORD CAN AND CANNOT SUPPORT. The four models were fitted on 2025-01-01 -> 2026-06-30 and the record starts the day after, so it is genuinely out of sample and the leakage audit proves the fence four ways. But it is still only a few hundred games per analyst: at n=330 the 95% interval on a hit rate is roughly +/-5.4 points, which is wider than any edge worth having. The STANDING HYGIENE RULE therefore applies in full — no model-performance conclusion is drawn from this record, in either direction, and a rate below 50% is no more a finding than a rate above it. What the re-architecture is actually for is DECORRELATION: the four now read disjoint features and their sides agree only about as often as coin flips would, which is what makes their disagreement worth rendering.

patterns.honest_note: THE PATTERN TABLE IS A MEASUREMENT, NOT A BET RULE. Every row carries its n and an EXACT binomial (Clopper-Pearson) 95% interval; a hit rate whose interval straddles 50% is a coin flip no matter how far from 50% the point estimate looks, and a row is a FINDING only if it survives ONE Benjamini-Hochberg pass across the entire rendered family. REPOINTED 2026-07-31: the four sides come from the re-architected v2 analysts (analyst_v2_stream.reads_for_date, the published chief contract) — SCOUT the arms, NOVA the bats, ATLAS the conditions, VEGA the price — not from the four ledgers of the previous analysts, which no longer exist. THE BUCKETS MOVED AND THAT IS NOT A RESULT: the re-architecture decorrelated the four deliberately, so they disagree far more (side agreement fell from 0.84-0.89 to 0.51-0.57) and all sixteen configurations now occur where most previously never did. Different population is not better or worse performance. The corpus restarts at 2026-07-01, the day after the training fence of 2026-06-30, so it is genuinely out of sample and genuinely small — it will stay small for months and the intervals say so. The two eras are computed and shown separately and are NEVER summed: `reconstructed_era` is the July slate priced after the fact by models fitted before it, `live_era` is reads served before the games were played. Betting confidence remains solely the champion EV gate + the star system — nothing in this table gates, sizes or creates a bet.
